assumptions: Positive uniform spine conductance t, unit pendant weights, at least two leaves per hub, independent vertex-coordinate inputs.
integrity: The theorem and finite exact-rational checks are separately described; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No guarantee of a well-conditioned control Gramian close to a resonance; unequal spine weights, directed edges and arbitrary input combinations are outside scope. Published historical coverage is non-exhaustive.
title: Sharp weighted-bridge resonances and minimum vertex actuation on two-hub trees
